authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/sequential/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/sequential/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's NRPN tables, on its number, with its printed range and name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Values go out as the manual prints the format: NRPN MSB/LSB on CC 99/98, value MSB/LSB on CC 6/38. The instrument must have its Global MIDI parameter receive set to NRPN (or All).
1 parameter(s) the manual marks as transmitted but ignored when received are read-only.
Identity as printed: manufacturer 02 ("Oberheim ID") and family 5AH 01H, the same in every SysEx message of the document. Not yet checked against the instrument.
No preset recall: the document numbers banks three ways (Bank Select received 1 - 12, transmitted 0 - 9, a program dump request 0 - 15).
The Program table is headed "program parameters 0-352" and prints NRPNs 1 - 187.
Left out, the high bits of Filter Cutoff (34) and Filter State (38), which those NRPNs already carry whole; the manual does not say when the halves are sent on their own: NRPN 35, 39.
Left out, printed without a range: NRPN 41 (Unused).
